spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रजति व्राजयति)
To go, to travel.
With परि prefixed,
To wander about, as a mendicant.
r. 10th cl.
To prepare, to perfect.

m. (-जः)
1 A cow-pen, a station of cowherds.
2 A road.
3 A flock, a herd, a multitude.
4 The district about Agra and [] Mathurā, the scene of KṚṢṆA'S juvenile adventures.
n. (-जं)
Wandering, roaming.
E.
व्रज to go, aff. घ.

mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्)
Going, roaming.
E.
व्रज to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Going, roaming.
E.
व्रज to go, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-भूः)
A tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.)
E.
व्रज a cow-pen, and भू being.

n. (-रं)
A cow-yard, a cattle fold or pen.
E.
व्रज, and अजिर a yard.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone, going.
n. (-तं)
Roaming.
E.
व्रज to go, क्त aff.

f. (-ज्या)
1 Wandering about, either as an act of religious austerity or in quest of alms.
2 March of an assailant, attack, invasion.
3 March in general.
4 A class, a flock, a tribe.
5 A theatre.
E.
व्रज to go, क्यप् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Wandering, roaming.
2 Going gracefully.
E.
व्रज्या, and मतुप् aff.

r. 1st cl. (व्रणति)
To sound.
r. 10th cl. (व्रणयति)
To wound.

mn. (-णः-णं)
A tumor, a boil; an ulcer, a wound.
E.
व्रण to wound, an abscess, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Making a sore, wounding, ulcerating, corroding, &c.
m. (-कृत्)
Marking-nut plant, (Semecarpus anacardium.)
E.
व्रण a sore, and कृत् what makes.

m. (-द्विट्)
A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
E.
वृण a sore, and द्विष् hostile to, healing.

n. (-नं)
Fumigating a sore.
E.
व्रण, and धूपन burning incense.

n. (-स्तुः)
Part liable to ulcerate, as skin, flesh, &c.
E.
व्रण, and वस्तु substance.

f. (-ना)
Pain of a wound or sore.
E.
व्रण, and वेदना pain.

n. (-नं)
Cleaning or cicatrising a sore.
E.
व्रण, and शोधन cleaning.

m. (-हः)
The castor oil tree.
f. (-हा)
A sort of creeper, (Menispermum glabrum.)
E.
व्रण a sore, and हन to destroy, aff. क.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Having a boil, a sore or wound.
E.
व्रण, and इनि aff.

mn. (-तः-तं)
1 Any meritorious act of devotion, the voluntary or vowed observance, or imposition of any penance, austerity, or privation, as fasting, continence, exposure to heat and cold, &c.
2 Eating.
E.
वृ to choose, aff. अतच्, र substituted for the vowel, or व्रज to go, (to heaven by it,) घ aff. and the form irr.

m. (-तः)
1 A multitude, an assemblage.
2 The descendant of an outcaste Brahman, &c.
3 The company and attendants at a marriage feast.
n. (-तं)
1 Manual or bodily labour.
2 Day labour, employment of a precarious kind.
E.
वृ to choose, aff. अतच्, and the vowel made long; or व्रत a religious observance, or व्रात्य an outcaste, aff. अण्.

f. (-तिः-ती)
1 Expansion, spreading.
2 A creeper.
E.
वृत to abide, अति aff., the vowel changed to its congener.

f. (-क्षा)
Soliciting alms, as one of the ceremonies accompanying investiture.
E.
व्रत the observance of investiture, and भिक्षा begging.

n. (-नं)
Violating a religious vow or obligation.
E.
व्रत, and लोपन cutting off.

m. (-हः)
Engaging in any act of devotion, taking on one's self some voluntary religious obligation.
E.
व्रत a vow, and संग्रह taking.

m. (-कः)
The Brahman who has completed his term of studentship.
E.
व्रत, and स्नातक a householder.

n. (-णं)
Observing a religious obligation, especially continence, as the duty of the student.
E.
व्रत, and आचरण going.

m. (-शः)
Investiture of a youth of either of the first three classes with the characteristic cord.
E.
व्रत the observance, and आदेश pointing out.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Engaged in or observing a religious vow or obligation.
m. (-ती)
1 An employer of priests.
2 An ascetic, a devotee, one engaged in the observance of a vow or penance.
3 The religious student.
E.
व्रत a vow, and इनि aff.

m. (-सः)
Fasting, a fast, (as a religious penance or obligation.)
E.
व्रत, and उपवास fasting.

m. (-ध्नः)
The sun.

(ओ उ) ओव्रश्चु r. 6th cl. (वृश्चति)
To cut.

m. (-नः)
A small saw or chisel.
n. (-नं)
Cutting.
E.
व्रश्च to cut, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-जिः)
A gale of wind.
E.
व्रज to go, इञ् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
1 A cooly, a hired porter or labourer.
2 One who has no fixed or stated employment.
E.
व्रात bodily labour, and ख aff.

m. (-त्यः)
A Brahman, or man of the three first classes, in whose youth the customary observances have been omitted, and who has not received his investiture with the sacred thread.
f. (-त्या)
A female of a fallen Brahman, &c.
E.
व्रात, and य aff.

f. (ता)
The condition of one who has lost caste by neglect of the initiatory observances.
E.
व्रात्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, व्रात्यत्वं.

m. (-मः)
A particular sacrifice performed to recover the rights forfeited by an improper delay of the ceremony of investiture.
E.
व्रात्य one not invested, &c., and स्तोम a sacrifice.
